question: A parallel plate capacitor with plate separation $d$ is connected to a battery of voltage $V$. A dielectric slab of thickness $x$ ($x < d$) and dielectric constant $K$ is inserted between the plates. Analyze the energy density $u$ of the electric field in the air gap ($u_{air}$) versus the energy density in the dielectric slab ($u_{slab}$). What is the ratio $u_{air} / u_{slab}$?
